title: porophyllum ruderale
intro: Porophyllum ruderale, commonly known as Mexican tea or yaupon tea, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, lowering blood sugar levels, and providing antioxidant and antimicrobial benefits. The health benefits of Porophyllum ruderale are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions also include cardiotonic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions.
